description: This file is a Lua script primarily for testing various functionalities of the Lua table library, including unpack, pack, move, and sort. It contains test cases, error checks, and performance measurements for table operations.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: A helper function that runs a function call expecting it to error with a specific message.

methods.name: check
methods.description: A function that verifies the table is sorted according to a provided comparison function.

methods.name: perm
methods.description: Generates permutations of input sequences to test sorting.

methods.name: timesort
methods.description: Measures and verifies the time taken to sort a list of elements.
